projects.name: winwin-shop
projects.description: Freelance client work, live and in active use: a marketplace where businesses pay content creators for the sales they bring. Per-creator Shopify discount codes with click and conversion tracking; orders captured by a webhook + 5-minute cron hybrid so nothing is lost when a webhook is missed; monthly creator payouts via PayPlus card vaulting behind a 125-endpoint REST API; an OpenAI support chatbot served from AWS Lambda.
note: // PayPlus payouts · OpenAI chatbot on Lambda

projects.name: shop-saver
projects.description: Finds the cheapest nearby grocery basket across Israeli supermarket chains. A Python + Rust ingestion pipeline pulls the chains' daily price feeds (2,500+ items each) with deduplication and retry logic; React + MUI frontend with Hebrew RTL support, all on PostgreSQL in Docker.

projects.name: devclip
projects.description: Turns throwaway developer snippets — shell commands, SQL, regexes — into a searchable library. A global hotkey opens a palette that pastes straight into the app you were in. Fuzzy matcher aware of word boundaries and camelCase, ranked by recency and frequency; pure-Rust core with 37 unit tests, signed Windows and macOS releases built in CI.
note: // signed windows + macos releases via CI
